snippet.title: Donutal | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
New alien conversation adventure Donutal
Scheduled for release on Steam in 2026
*The footage is from the Japanese version of the game. The demo and final product will include English.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

■Wishlist Now!
We are excited to announce that the Wishlist is now live for Donutal on Steam®.

Please Wishlist the game on Steam👇️
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3971730/Donutal/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=donutal_yt

Official Website:
https://www.arcsystemworks.jp/donutal/en.html

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// About the Game //
Donutal is an alien conversation adventure game where you uncover true identities through "conversation."
The game is set in the year 2206 at an International Space Port built upon the remains of the former ISS. Players take on the role of an "Chief Extraterrestrial Counselor" who has awakened from a 150-year cryosleep. To repay a massive debt they have no memory of incurring, the player must screen aliens arriving on Earth.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
